name: compare-anything
description: Evidence-backed comparisons of companies and products in four gated steps: research, approve a criteria framework, freeze a fact-checked baseline, then compare and review. Claude researches and writes; Jev fact-checks every claim against verbatim excerpts. Includes a local review UI.
